gradient_row_rule: First 32 stored fitting-bank rows in their existing order
candidate_rule: Float32 feasible actions in [-1,1]^4, stable exact deduplication; actor first
scale_weighting: Equal states, then equal candidate actions within each state
gradient_identity_rule: L2(error) <= atol + rtol * max(L2(left), L2(right)); scalar and array checks retain elementwise allclose
selection_rule: No coefficient, winner, or production normalization is selected
candidate_scale: stop_gradient(C_Q/C_U), applied only to the penalty inside the existing c-weighted actor objective; diagnostic only
scale_failure_policy: Nonfinite inputs invalidate checks; zero or near-constant centered scales are explicitly unavailable with no fallback factor
counterfactual_unit_change: Scale frozen Q outputs, hypothetical rewards, and actual frozen residual_scale together; hold weights and dimensionless calibration thresholds fixed
unchanged_production: No native epsilon, network, optimizer, objective, threshold, reward processing or runtime precision changes
preregistration_scope: Checks fixed before this fitting-only stage executes, after observing the separate development diagnostic; not a preregistration of the earlier study
limitations: Within-state subtraction of an action-independent constant cannot change exact action rankings.
Candidate-bank contrasts are distinct from action and actor-parameter gradients.
U already has reward/Q units; C_Q/C_U is a dimensionless contrast-matching factor, not a required unit conversion.
A matching factor can alter optimization geometry and must be detached; its usefulness is untested.
The relative contrast usability rule is numerical, not statistical, and its raw-RMS denominator is sensitive to additive offsets; no whole-procedure offset invariance is claimed.
Absolute tie tolerances and floating-point rounding can break exact numerical ranking invariance near ties.
Native fixed epsilon breaks exact unit invariance near zero Q; co-scaled epsilon is a labeled counterfactual only.
Frozen unit algebra does not establish training invariance: residual-unit initialization/EMA floors, optimizer epsilon and training dynamics remain unchanged.
U remains a one-step twin-min TD-residual proxy, not Q1 value-error coverage.
